sources.title: CWC Outreach Worker Service-Navigation Promotion Standard
sources.sections: Owner Direction; Intended Editorial Rule; Role Boundary
sources.point_of_use_reliability: AUTHORITATIVE for the project's editorial CTA scope: DM navigation support, no claims of 24/7 availability/guaranteed services, decisions remain clinical; not medical evidence

claims.text: An HIV diagnosis does not prevent a person from having a long and healthy life when treatment and care are effective; no individual outcome is guaranteed.
claims.limits: Avoid absolute prognosis or equivalence for all individuals.

claims.text: HIV is manageable with antiretroviral treatment; ART suppresses viral replication but does not cure HIV.
claims.limits: The copy does not claim that HIV has been cured.

claims.text: Effective ART supports the immune system and ongoing health.
claims.limits: May not imply every complication is eliminated.

claims.text: Following HIV diagnosis, people should be offered prompt linkage to ART and clinical consultation.
claims.limits: A positive test is followed by appropriate diagnostic confirmation and care, without universal guarantees about local treatment timing.

claims.text: ART start time is clinician-guided, including specific exceptional clinical situations where short deferral may be needed.
claims.limits: Exceptions such as TB/cryptococcal meningitis are not patient self-triage instructions; no blanket postponement message.

claims.text: Using ART as clinically directed and remaining engaged in follow-up supports treatment response.
claims.limits: No fixed frequency, regimen, dose or medication selection specified.

claims.text: Viral-load testing measures response to ART and whether viral replication is being adequately suppressed.
claims.limits: No local clinic VL interval, guarantee of undetectability, or patient-specific interpretation asserted.

claims.text: HIV status does not diminish a person's worth, and stigmatizing language/discrimination should be avoided.
claims.limits: Ethical/editorial statement; do not classify as a clinical outcome claim.

claims.text: Audience may contact the CWC outreach worker managing the account by DM for HIV information and service navigation.
claims.limits: No verified hours, named clinic availability, pricing, guaranteed response, diagnosis, medical advice or referral outcome.

claims.text: Only clinical health services/qualified healthcare staff should decide testing interpretation, diagnosis and treatment.
claims.limits: Outreach worker provides education/navigation, not prescribing.

claims.text: Follow/share CTA and five hashtags including #Manado are intentional editorial engagement elements.
claims.limits: No biomedical statement; CPB §6.6.1/§6.6.2 must be verified independently in STG-05 editorial gate.

regulatory_context: Indonesian Permenkes 3/2026 effective March 11, 2026 repeals most of Permenkes 23/2022, with specified exception; the content makes no claim about current 2026 Manado facility service protocol, viral-load interval or medicine availability. International references serve evidence, not local structural authority.
